decisions.decision: Halted /gsd-autonomous at the blocker gate instead of running discuss/plan/execute on Phases 20/22
decisions.rationale: Both are status:human_needed with context already gathered, so the workflow would have gone straight to plan->execute and written plans/summaries for work no agent can perform. Recorded anti-pattern.

decisions.decision: Track D (the Trivy fix) is the only agent-executable work left in v1.4, and it is a prerequisite for Track B, not a side quest
decisions.rationale: A block-flip cannot be validated against a red baseline

decisions.decision: Fixed the CVEs by upgrade in two places rather than one
decisions.rationale: The SARIF shows two distinct targets: cryptography lives in app/.venv (lockfile-reachable), setuptools+msgpack live in the base image's system site-packages (only reachable from the Dockerfile). A lockfile bump alone cannot clear the latter two.

decisions.decision: setuptools pinned >=83.0.0 rather than the 78.1.1 gate minimum
decisions.rationale: Clears CVE-2026-59890 (MEDIUM) in the same move so the SARIF stays quiet. Zero risk: the app runs from /app/.venv and never uses system setuptools.

decisions.decision: Did NOT repin the python:3.12-slim base digest
decisions.rationale: Checked the registry: the latest 3.12-slim index (sha256:57cd7c3a...) carries the same PYTHON_VERSION 3.12.13 as the current pin and declares no setuptools version, so a repin would not predictably clear the finding. Explicit upgrade is the targeted lever.

decisions.decision: Held .planning/STATE.md out of the Track D commit
decisions.rationale: Unrelated doc sync from the resume; keeps the PR diff to the three files CI actually cares about
Phase 22 live UAT is the capstone acceptance gate
